text: Sorry if this is a silly one. Im a childminder and one of my little ones (girl, 2) has a temp of 38.8. She keeps tugging at her right ear and said "ear hurt" a couple of times. Also she hasnt done a poo in 3 days and shes grumpy about it, keeps pushing then giving up. Otherwise shes wide awake, watching tv and chattering to me, and her breathing seems totaly normal. Mum is on her way but I wasnt sure if I should be doing anything in the meantime or if Im overreacting tbh
